caseName: Santos v. Power Auth. of State
caseNameFull: Nadia DOS SANTOS v. POWER AUTHORITY OF STATE OF NEW YORK

opinions.text: Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma pauperis denied. Petitioner allowed until October 28, 2013, within which to pay the docketing fee required by Rule 38(a) and to submit to a petition in compliance with Rule 33.1 of the Rules of this Court.
